fields.label: Specimen
fields.help: Measured from the 18 standalone HER2 requests in the 2024-2026 export: breast 12, lymph node 3, soft tissue 1, liver 1.

fields.label: Side / procedure
fields.placeholder: left 8 o'clock, 2 cm FN, core biopsy
fields.help: Printed after the organ, as the request writes it. Leave blank if the request says no more than the organ.

fields.label: Paraffin block
fields.help: The block the section was cut from, under its earlier accession. Prints in the specimen line as "paraffin block (26BX-012345)" before "for HER-2 DISH test"; left out when blank.

fields.label: HER2 DISH calculator
fields.help: HER2 (black) and CEP17 (red) signals in at least 20 non-overlapping invasive tumour nuclei, as on the QMH calculator. The cells counted, both averages, the ratio and the result below fill in from the counts; Enter moves to the next box. Not printed.

fields.label: Concurrent HER2 IHC score (Groups 2-4)
fields.help: Not printed. Groups 2-4 take their result from it (ASCO/CAP 2018; CAP 2023 algorithm): Groups 2 and 4 are positive only with IHC 3+, Group 3 with IHC 2+ or 3+; IHC 2+ asks for a blinded recount by a second observer first.

fields.label: HER2/neu oncoprotein DISH
options: Positive (amplified, Group 1 result in greater than 10% of cell population)

fields.label: DISH - Number of tumor cells counted
DISH - Average HER2 signals (black) per cell
DISH - Average CEP17 signals (red) per cell
Cold ischemia time (min)
fields.help: Optimal <= 60 min; > 60 min prolonged. Leave blank if unknown.

fields.label: Fixation time in buffered formalin (hours)
fields.help: Inadequate < 6 h; optimal 6-72 h; > 72 h prolonged. Leave blank if unknown.

fields.label: Test type
options: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) cleared (specify test / vendor):
Laboratory-developed test (Health Canada Approved (specify test / vendor:).

snippets.label: Cannot be determined - HER2 FISH to follow
snippets.text: HER2 FISH will be attempted; the results will be issued in a separate report.
